_note: AI grader test set (npm run eval). Merged 2026-10-10: t01-t31 by quantrungvu's Claude, j01-j35 from Jerry's set. Drafts by Claude; Jerry reviews (and a native speaker should check). Run `npm run eval` before changing prompts/check-sentence.md or CLAUDE_MODEL. word = id in data/words.json, template = id in data/structures.json. 'tags' is a list of groups: each group lists acceptable tags, and the AI must return at least one tag from every group. Empty tags = the sentence is correct. is_correct null = don't check. has_major (optional) = whether any mistake must be 'major'. expected_corrected is a guide for humans, not an exact match. skip = not run yet, with the reason. learner_gender is not sent to the AI yet (the app has no learner gender); cases that need it are skipped.
